examples.arabic: بابا بيحكي نكتة حلوة وكلنا بنضحك بصوت عالي
examples.english: Dad is telling a nice joke and we are all laughing out loud.
examples.transliteration: Baba beyḥaky nokta ḥelwa w kollena benedḥak beṣoot 'aly.

examples.english: My classmate laughs a lot and tells a joke.
examples.transliteration: Zameeli biyedhak keteer w bi'ool nokta.
